name: Track release promo, night
note: A release promo for a real record: night, road, sky. The first brief in this repo with a SUBJECT in the ordinary sense -- it is about something, and it ends by saying what. Everything before it was a montage that could not state its own claim.
subject: car tail lights on a dark highway
a road at night with headlights
driving at night through a tunnel
city lights seen from above at night
a city street at night
a starry night sky
mood_weight_note: Zero because this track has no observations.mood: MuQ is not installed in work/audio, so listen/deep.py failed and no mood or novelty was measured. A non-zero weight here would name an influence that is not acting. The mood bridge is demonstrated on dont-look-down, which has the field.
subject_note: Night, named as night. The previous version asked for "a road" and got a road at noon, because the vocabulary could not express time of day. It can now, and the pool was refetched from night/drive/highway/traffic so the words have something to match.
